full_name: Luke Fowler | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Luke Fowler is an artist, filmmaker, and musician whose recent research is focused on two distinct areas: the cultural history and apparatus of early electronic music—in particular the work of composer Martin Bartlett and early computer music languages—and a reconciliation and expansion of his work in sound and still photography.
